metadata.title: YApi old/new UI acceptance coverage
metadata.candidate_scope: Source-reviewed working-tree overlay on 889b7b5f28f7062d51901107868ab958c0f89af1. Includes schema control/boolean/rename restoration, Group/Project navigation repairs and intentional statistics administrator enforcement. Overlay SHA-256 values below identify reviewed bytes; no future commit SHA or final CI result is assumed.
metadata.method: Read-only source and AST review plus planned UI acceptance assertions. A separate exact-commit verification ledger below records completed CI evidence. The inventory itself did not execute tests, and CI checks do not convert the broader 246 old/new comparison assertions into passes.
metadata.browser_blocker: Cloud paired browsing remains blocked by URL-policy/resolution restrictions. The Mac fallback is explicitly authorized and preparation has started; Mac runtime and paired old/new execution remain not_run.

status_definitions.source_reviewed: Source existence and shape reviewed; not runtime proof.
status_definitions.tested_pass: The explicitly named check executed successfully on the ledger commit, within its stated boundary. It does not imply whole-page or paired-version acceptance.
status_definitions.tested_fail: The explicitly named check executed and failed on the ledger commit; partial earlier passes do not make the test pass.
status_definitions.blocked: Execution cannot proceed because a named access, environment or permission prerequisite is unavailable.
status_definitions.not_run: The full planned assertion has not been executed with sufficient evidence; partial or unrelated checks do not change this status.

metadata.external_test_reports: Separate test results or CI reports must be linked and scoped to their exact commit. They do not convert these 246 planned assertions into passes.

ci_status_at_update.note: Four existing browser flows passed; the statistics browser test failed its final no-pageerror assertion. All 246 planned old/new acceptance assertions remain not_run.

comparison_blockers: Cloud paired browsing remains blocked by URL-policy/resolution restrictions.
metadata.manifest_note: Overlay manifest hashes identify source/test/document files present at this refresh. Hash inclusion alone does not mean that every file or added test was executed.

findings.title: Invalid schema JSON can leave stale parent data in the initial candidate
findings.before: In 0bce16f invalid raw JSON changed local text only; Save validated the previous parent schema and dirty state did not receive that invalid edit.
findings.current: The inherited a304004 parent-form guards remain, and the current overlay parses object/boolean schemas without coercing empty invalid drafts. Invalid JSON reports invalidity without replacing the last valid schema. This is source-fixed pending exact-final CI; the broader error→Save/cancel/reopen scenarios remain not_run.

findings.title: Sample-JSON import and tree collapse restored
findings.before: 0bce16f replaced the historical schema package with a fully expanded fieldset UI without sample-JSON import or node collapse.
findings.current: Current source retains the a304004 compact row tree, per-node collapse, explicit example/Schema import and add/remove controls. Import, advanced and multiline dialogs stage changes and use non-dismissible masks with Cancel/Close/Escape available. Source restoration is pending exact-final CI and does not establish complete visual parity.

findings.title: Core historical schema controls restored; narrower interaction differences remain
findings.before: The old shipped schema editor exposes require-all, per-node advanced JSON settings, expanded multiline description/Mock editing, and Mock-option selection.
findings.current: The overlay restores recursive require-all, per-node advanced JSON and multiline description/Mock dialogs. It still does not recreate legacy type-specific advanced form fields, separate Title inputs or Mock autocomplete choices; these values remain available in advanced JSON. The inline tree shows the first tuple item and caps depth at 12. Runtime and paired visual comparison remain not_run.

findings.title: Boolean-root schema and preview support restored in source
findings.before: Full old-version behavior for boolean-root schemas is not established by this review.
findings.current: parseSchema now accepts object or boolean schemas in raw JSON, schema import and per-node advanced dialogs. Actual false data remains false instead of becoming an empty object. SchemaTable explicitly describes allow-any true and allow-none false. This is source-fixed pending exact-final CI; no paired runtime pass is claimed.

findings.title: Rejected field rename now restores the displayed serialized name
findings.before: Current implementation uses an uncontrolled defaultValue name input.
findings.current: Controlled nameDraft, visible validation and reset on blank/whitespace/duplicate rename replace the prior uncontrolled input. Escape restores the name; successful rename updates matching required references. This is source-fixed pending exact-final CI and full Save/reopen acceptance.

findings.title: Admin upgrade notification removed from shell
findings.before: Old Application mounted Notify for global admin; Notify fetched external version information and offered a dismissible version-details link.
findings.current: Current Application no longer imports or mounts Notify. Confirm whether removing external version notification is accepted rather than expecting old banner parity.

findings.title: Collection ordering migrated to native table and drag handlers
findings.before: Old collection table used React DnD and reactabular/table-resolver.
findings.current: Current table is native HTML with native drag/drop and added up/down buttons. Ordering persistence, selected rows, first/last disabled controls, repeated click, browser back and report formatting require actual interaction checks.

findings.title: Legacy AntD selectors remain a visual migration risk
findings.before: AntD 3 selectors targeted confirm, tabs, tree and select structures that changed in AntD 6.
findings.current: The shared body/theme/search fixes address major defaults. Remaining old structural selectors in common.scss, interface.scss, Edit.scss, ProjectList.scss and ProjectData.scss need rendered inspection; source presence is not a reproduced failure.

findings.title: Statistics cursor and chart failure-state fixes are committed in the reviewed candidate
findings.before: Initial candidate used aggregate().cursor({}).exec(), incompatible with the current cursor API; chart did not clear loading on failed requests.
findings.current: Base commit 889b7b5 removes cursor.exec(), awaits cursor.eachAsync, handles malformed/network responses, offers Retry and ignores stale/unmounted requests. Its CI statistics API/geometry/empty/error-retry assertions passed before the separate final pageerror failure. The historical CI ledger is retained; overlay acceptance is pending.

findings.title: Stored HTML is sanitized in migrated display paths
findings.before: Old interface/wiki/import-diff/timeline rendering inserted stored HTML directly.
findings.current: Sanitization is a protective change; representative historical HTML, tables, links and images need rendering comparison. Unsafe HTML should not be preserved merely to match the old appearance.

findings.title: Group and project startup/navigation race repaired in source
findings.before: CI on 889b7b5 failed the statistics flow final no-pageerror assertion after login/group startup requested group data without an id.
findings.current: The overlay validates numeric route/resource IDs, uses action-result data rather than stale connected props, rejects stale/unmounted responses, follows absolute group routes, adds retry/empty/error states, and refreshes group/project/settings from the route-selected entity. Exact-final CI and paired browser acceptance remain pending.

findings.title: Statistics administrator enforcement is an intentional security correction
findings.before: Legacy admin-only menu did not protect every endpoint: the old chart check used !this.getRole() === admin, and other statistics actions lacked the administrator guard.
findings.current: All four statistics read actions now call requireAdministrator before querying cross-project/system data. The page refuses non-admin direct navigation and skips protected requests. This intentionally tightens legacy access; it is not a parity regression to preserve. Exact-final CI and role-specific runtime acceptance remain pending.

surfaces.title: Shell, authentication boundary and navigation

scenarios.assertion: Open every top-level route directly and through navigation, including refresh, trailing slash, invalid IDs and unknown path
login redirect preserves intended behavior and does not loop
logo, breadcrumbs and Back/Forward lead to the intended project/group
close browser-support warning and reopen navigation without layout obstruction

surfaces.title: Header guidance and user menu

scenarios.assertion: Advance or skip each guidance popover and verify stored completion after reload
open/close/reopen avatar menu by click, outside click and Escape
ordinary users do not receive admin menu entries and direct routes still enforce authorization
logout clears authenticated shell and Back does not recover private content

surfaces.title: Public home and Mock demonstration

scenarios.assertion: Login/register and documentation links land correctly
Mock-rule input generates expected sample and reports malformed input
sample scroll, animation and layout do not cover controls
authenticated home redirect matches baseline and browser history remains usable

surfaces.title: Normal login, LDAP and SSO entry

scenarios.assertion: Required email/password validation is visible and blocks submission
valid login sets session and navigates correctly
repeated login and Enter do not cause duplicate navigation
switch provider and return after cancelled/failed SSO or LDAP, retaining only appropriate input and errors

surfaces.title: Registration and disabled registration

scenarios.assertion: Validate name/email/password/confirmation and visible errors
successful creation navigates and session behaves like baseline
disabled registration explains state and cannot submit by direct tab or repeated click
switch login/register, Back and reopen without stale validation or duplicate creation

surfaces.title: Global user, group, project and interface search

scenarios.assertion: Type and clear search, select each result type and verify exact destination
hidden private data is absent for nonmembers
rapid searches cannot show stale results for an older query
keyboard selection, blur, outside click and reopen preserve sensible focus and dismiss overlays

surfaces.title: Profile display, account edits, avatar and password

scenarios.assertion: Profile facts and timestamps match selected uid
modify username/email, Cancel, reopen and save, verifying reload persistence
password rules/current-password failure and confirmation mismatch remain visible and no stale values survive cancel
permitted JPG/PNG avatar up to 200KB previews/uploads while invalid files and unauthorized edits are blocked

surfaces.title: Administrative user list

scenarios.assertion: Search user names and clear filter, inspect pagination and profile links
admin delete exposes confirmation and Cancel causes no deletion
confirmed deletion updates only selected row and repeated click does not delete another user
non-admin sees no destructive control and server rejects direct unauthorized attempt

surfaces.title: Followed projects and project-card actions

scenarios.assertion: Open followed project cards and verify role/read access
toggle follow repeatedly and reconcile icon, count and server state on reload
cancelling delete/unfollow flow leaves intended state
removed or inaccessible projects render a clear empty/error outcome

surfaces.title: Group sidebar, search and add-group dialog

scenarios.assertion: Select and search groups and verify project/member/log/settings content resets to selected group
add group validates name, description and owner selection
Cancel/Close/reopen does not create or leak values between groups
repeated create submits once and Back/Forward highlights correct group

surfaces.title: Group project cards and add-project access

scenarios.assertion: Project cards show title/status/count and open correct route
personal-group followed/my-project sections remain laid out and independently clickable
Add project is enabled only when role permits, otherwise explanation appears
create/follow/delete errors leave cards and counts synchronized after reload

surfaces.title: Create project form

scenarios.assertion: Validate project name/group/base path and permission choice
ineligible group options are disabled
submit correct name, description, basepath and visibility and open new project
repeated create, Back and revisit do not clone project or reuse another group

surfaces.title: Group member management

scenarios.assertion: Add exact selected user with owner/dev/guest role and prevent duplicate user
role changes persist and inherited project rights reflect change
deletion Cancel keeps member, confirmation removes only intended member
nonowners cannot mutate members, including direct requests

surfaces.title: Group and project activity, pagination and diff

scenarios.assertion: Filter log type and load more without duplicate/missing rows
expand/collapse change details with sanitized readable content
follow interface/user links and return to same context
download Mock/history data and verify generated content and permission

surfaces.title: Group settings, custom field and deletion

scenarios.assertion: Edit group name/description/custom-field toggle and required custom-field name, save and reload
Cancel or close danger section causes no deletion
typed group-name confirmation only authorizes intended group deletion
owner can edit but admin-only delete visibility remains and other roles cannot write

surfaces.title: Project subnavigation and plugin tabs

scenarios.assertion: Project root redirects to interface list and subnav highlights exact destination
personal-group projects hide both member link and member route
configured plugins appear once and tab switching works after rerender
changing project ID updates all state and Back/Forward never retains previous-project controls

surfaces.title: Project configuration and destructive operations

scenarios.assertion: Edit project name/group/basepath/description/tags and save/reload
permission, strict Mock validation, JSON5 and notification toggles persist exact booleans
project move and visibility controls follow role restrictions
danger Cancel preserves data and name-confirmed delete targets only current project

surfaces.title: Tag editor and interface tag selection

scenarios.assertion: Add/edit/delete tags and descriptions and preserve selected tags on interface
close or cancel tag modal does not persist edits unexpectedly
save tag modal refreshes options without wiping unsaved interface fields
duplicate/empty tags and removed selected tags behave consistently

surfaces.title: Environment list and environment editor

scenarios.assertion: Add, select and rename environment
edit domain and header name/value rows and save exact order/data
deletion confirmation Cancel retains environment and confirmed deletion reconciles runners
close/reopen inline runner environment modal and verify cancel/save propagation without stale selection

surfaces.title: Pre-request and pre-response scripts

scenarios.assertion: Toggle and edit both scripts then save/reload exact source
editor syntax errors are shown without unintended submission
authorized runner executes configured scripts and unconfigured runner displays actionable failure
script network default-deny and allowlist failures cannot appear as a successful request

surfaces.title: Project token display, copy and refresh

scenarios.assertion: Guest has no token tab
permitted users read/copy correct project's token
owner/admin refresh updates value and obsolete value loses intended capability
dev/nonmember direct refresh is denied and repeated refresh does not leave UI with an older returned value

surfaces.title: Global Mock script

scenarios.assertion: Enable/edit/save global script and reload
disable prevents script effects
Mock request reflects script only under supported runner capability
save/execution failure leaves clear state and no false success

surfaces.title: Project members, roles, notifications and bulk import

scenarios.assertion: Add selected user, change owner/dev/guest role and verify persisted rights
per-member email notification toggle follows owner/admin restriction
bulk import from selected project displays correct candidates and Cancel imports none
delete confirmation/repeated add cannot remove or duplicate wrong member

surfaces.title: Interface category tree, search, drag and menus

scenarios.assertion: Search and clear matches
expanding and selecting category/API update correct route and highlight
add/edit/delete category and add/copy/delete interface menu actions call correct IDs
drag category ordering and move interface across category persist after reload
Cancel/reopen context modal and browser Back preserve selected node and no overlay trap

surfaces.title: Add interface and category forms

scenarios.assertion: Required category/title/path validation and method options work
create interface populates target category and navigates correct ID
category name/description creation and editing persist
Cancel/Close/Escape/reopen and rapid submits produce no accidental duplicate

surfaces.title: Interface table filters and bulk operations

scenarios.assertion: Filter by completed/unfinished, tag and public/open interface state, combine and clear filters
title/path links and add button route correctly
row selection/bulk action operates only selected records and selection clears on relevant navigation
pagination, sort and row-click behavior remain consistent after data changes

surfaces.title: Interface documentation preview and copy

scenarios.assertion: Render title/creator/status/time/path and copy complete path including basepath
display required flags, examples, descriptions, file fields and JSON schemas correctly
nested schema expand/collapse keeps keywords visible and safe long-content layout
legacy HTML formatting remains readable while dangerous HTML is stripped

surfaces.title: Interface editing and collaboration lock

scenarios.assertion: Edit title/category/method/path/status/tag/custom field/open flag/notification and save exact payload
websocket lock blocks simultaneous editor and failure state is explicit
required and duplicate/path validation is visible
save double-click/error/route-change does not silently lose edits or update another interface

surfaces.title: Path/query/header/form parameter editor

scenarios.assertion: Add/edit/remove query, header and body-form rows then save/reopen verifying exact count/order
rename path placeholders updates path-param metadata without leaving removed parameters
toggle required/file types and automatic Content-Type remains correct
drag rows and rapid add/delete retain the right values with no stale indexed fields

surfaces.title: Bulk parameter import overlay

scenarios.assertion: Open bulk import with current values, replace using name:example lines and verify exact parsing
malformed/empty lines are handled visibly
Cancel/Close/reopen leaves parent unchanged until import
repeated import and query/body switching do not duplicate or cross-populate parameters

surfaces.title: Body type, raw/JSON/JSON5 and preview

scenarios.assertion: Switch request body type and response JSON/raw without losing intended content or saving hidden stale fields
JSON5 enabled/disabled follows project setting and malformed data blocks saving
template→preview generates current content and reports parser/schema errors
fullscreen F9, blur, back and reopen restore usable editor and focus

surfaces.title: Visual schema editor and legacy control parity

scenarios.assertion: Add/delete/rename fields, change type/description/Mock and required flag, save/reopen and verify unknown keywords retained
compare legacy sample-JSON import, require-all, node advanced edit, multiline edit and expand/collapse surfaces against new replacement
array tuple edits preserve untouched tuple members and deep schemas remain accessible
duplicate/empty rename visibly rejects and resets displayed name rather than diverging from saved schema

surfaces.title: Raw schema JSON state and invalid edits

scenarios.assertion: Edit full schema and switch visual/JSON without dropping keywords or reformatting unexpectedly
invalid displayed JSON must prevent Save from reporting success with a stale previous schema
first invalid edit must participate in unsaved-change prompt
valid boolean schema and multi-type schemas should be represented honestly or limitation explained, not reported as invalid JSON

surfaces.title: Interface rich-text and Markdown editor

scenarios.assertion: Switch WYSIWYG/Markdown, format text/table/code/link/image and preserve content on save/reopen
legacy HTML-only descriptions load without markup corruption
typing only in rich text marks dirty and Cancel navigation preserves unsaved edits
unmount/reopen or rapid interface switching destroys old editor and prevents duplicate toolbar or cross-record changes

surfaces.title: Unsaved edit prompts and navigation interruption

scenarios.assertion: Changing tab with dirty edits shows one prompt, Cancel keeps current content and Confirm discards only intended changes
route navigation and browser Back/Forward use same decision semantics
repeated navigation while prompt open creates no stacked modal or blocker deadlock
reload/close browser warning appears only while dirty and disappears after save/discard

surfaces.title: Single-interface request runner

scenarios.assertion: Choose environment, edit path/query/header/body/file inputs and send intended method/URL
required fields cannot be silently disabled and optional inclusion works
switch browser/server modes and show extension/cross-origin/network/sandbox failure clearly
repeated send, navigation during request and late response do not overwrite another interface

surfaces.title: Response tabs, test assertions and HTML preview

scenarios.assertion: Request/response headers, status, timing and body render accurately for all content types
raw/pretty/preview and auto-preview switch without executing unsafe active content outside intended sandbox
test script toggle, editor and assertion results remain usable
failed HTTP/assertion/schema cases are distinct and old results clear before a new run

surfaces.title: Variable, Mock and helper-expression modal

scenarios.assertion: Open parameter expression editor for each supported field and insert selected variable/function/Mock rule
verify correct parameter path/index receives value
Cancel/Close leaves original value and reopen shows current value
run expression with missing prior-case output and show clear failure without leaking unrelated data

surfaces.title: Save request to collection and inline collection creation

scenarios.assertion: Name case and select collection, submit then open newly saved case with exact request data
inline create collection validates and updates destination options
Cancel/reopen preserves documented defaults without creating collection/case
repeated submit or response failure cannot duplicate case

surfaces.title: Collection and case tree, search, CRUD and drag

scenarios.assertion: Create/edit/delete/clone collection and create/delete/clone case with correct IDs and refreshed tree
search and case selection route/highlight correctly
drag collection or case within/across collections persists order and ownership
Cancel/Close/reopen and repeated context-menu click never affect adjacent record

surfaces.title: Import interfaces into test collection

scenarios.assertion: Choose source project and filter by category/status
selection updates as source/filter changes and no hidden stale IDs import
submit creates expected cases only and reports duplicate/inaccessible entries
Cancel/reopen and repeated confirm do not duplicate cases

surfaces.title: Collection case table and ordering

scenarios.assertion: Case names, corresponding-interface links, status, environment and selection map correct records
drag reorder and new up/down buttons persist exact order
first/last buttons disable correctly and repeated clicks never lose/duplicate rows
rerun, reload and browser Back preserve saved ordering and cases

surfaces.title: Collection global validation, variables and scripts
routes: /project/:id/interface/col/:actionId (通用规则配置 / 自定义测试脚本)

scenarios.assertion: Toggle HTTP-code/JSON/data-structure checks and persist rules
add/edit/delete global variables and reference from cases
edit/enable/save collection script and verify execution scope
Cancel/reopen and guest permissions preserve baseline with no hidden unauthorized write

surfaces.title: Collection bulk runner, progress and report

scenarios.assertion: Run selected/all cases with chosen environment and intended sequential variable dependencies
start loading/progress and final per-case report reflect actual results
repeated start, cancelled modal and route change do not overlap or corrupt run state
open/close/reopen report and inspect request/response/assertion data including failures

surfaces.title: Server automation URL and downloads

scenarios.assertion: Generate/copy exact test URL with selected environment/output/notification options
valid token runs intended project only and invalid token shows denial
download JSON/report data matches selected collection and preserves encoding
sandbox/network policy failures remain visible and do not look like empty successful tests

surfaces.title: Saved-case details and request save

scenarios.assertion: Edit case name/description and request values, save/reload exact data
corresponding-interface link opens right API and Back restores case
changed/deleted source API handles missing fields without crash
repeated Save, rejected permissions and late responses leave consistent state

surfaces.title: Advanced Mock script and expectation tabs

scenarios.assertion: Switch expectation/script tabs and toggle script enable
edit/save script with clear runner/syntax errors
add/edit/delete/reorder expectations and verify matched response priority
guest mutation controls and server authorization enforce permissions

surfaces.title: Mock expectation condition and response editor

scenarios.assertion: Set expectation name/IP/parameter filters and response status/delay/headers/body then save and verify matching request
add/remove condition/header rows with correct values and ordering
Cancel/Close/reopen no writes and no previous-expectation state
disable/delete confirmation and repeated Save affect intended expectation only

surfaces.title: Wiki read, edit, conflict and notification

scenarios.assertion: Display sanitized wiki and preserve normal headings/tables/images/links
owner/dev edit via WYSIWYG/Markdown, update and reload exact content
Cancel edit and reopen do not save draft and conflict prevents unauthorized overwrite
notification choice, repeated update and switching project prevent duplicate/stale updates

surfaces.title: Data import formats, modes, target category and file drop

scenarios.assertion: Select each installed importer, target default category and synchronization mode
file picker and drag/drop process valid input and display malformed input errors
normal skips duplicates, smart merge retains intended manual edits, full overwrite changes only explicit scope
repeated upload/cancel/navigation during import does not duplicate or falsely report completion

surfaces.title: Swagger URL import and diff review

scenarios.assertion: Enable URL import and validate supplied URL and target category
display readable sanitized import differences and exact added/updated/skipped counts
URL/network/auth/schema failure is clear and no partial success is hidden
repeated trigger or navigation during fetch cannot apply to a newly selected project

surfaces.title: HTML, Markdown, JSON and Swagger export

scenarios.assertion: Select every export format and verify filename/content/media type
category/API visibility filters limit output exactly and private APIs never leak
include-wiki toggle affects supported HTML/Markdown output
no-data, long Unicode paths and repeated export remain usable

surfaces.title: Swagger automatic synchronization

scenarios.assertion: Toggle sync and save URL/cron/mode with visible validation
reopen/reload reads saved config and last update
manual/import changes are preserved or replaced per selected mode and revision history captures intended writes
unauthorized guest and stale-owner job operations deny clearly with no misleading enabled state

surfaces.title: TypeScript services generation help and link

scenarios.assertion: Tab remains discoverable once and configuration reflects selected project
copy/install/config/generation instructions render fully at narrow widths
generated service source/download links target permitted project
changing project clears old-project information and direct unauthorized output is denied

surfaces.title: Administrative system statistics cards, charts and table

scenarios.assertion: Show group/project/API/test totals and OS/CPU/memory/mail states accurately
chart for last three months labels/tooltip/resize works
group detail table pagination/sort/links correspond to counts
non-admin hidden menu and direct-route/backend denial prevent disclosure

surfaces.title: Legacy admin upgrade notification removal

scenarios.assertion: Record that old shell mounted Notify only for admin while new does not mount it
if notification behavior is required, compare banner/current/latest/version-detail link and close behavior
confirm intentional removal policy rather than calling missing banner a visual pass

surfaces.title: AI documentation modal and provider consent

scenarios.assertion: Open on current interface and show exact document version/provider/model/outbound payload
unconfigured provider and unchecked consent disable generation
consent checkbox applies to displayed payload and is reset on close/reopen or document change
loading/Close/Escape/repeated open cannot strand overlay or reuse previous-interface state

surfaces.title: AI generation, diff, discard and accept

scenarios.assertion: Generate only after consent and show complete HTML/Markdown/field-annotation diff as safe text
discard saves nothing and retry uses intended idempotency
accept once creates revision then refreshes interface and clears proposal/consent
concurrent legacy edit produces visible stale error without overwriting newer document

surfaces.title: Documentation history, pagination and restore

scenarios.assertion: Load history and earlier pages without duplicate versions, retaining actor/time/kind
inspect current/original/old field snapshots and label incomplete history
Cancel restore writes nothing, confirm creates a new revision preserving history
repeated restore, navigation and stale version failure never rewrite another interface

cross_cutting_scenarios.assertion: Run as anonymous, global admin, owner, developer, guest and unrelated user, with public/private project and inherited group rights; UI hiding and server denial must both be verified.
Run empty, loading, populated, slow request, network error, server validation error and permission revoked states; stale success and infinite spinner are failures.
For every dialog/popover/editor: open, edit, Cancel, reopen, close icon, Escape, outside click and save; verify exactly the intended persistence and focus return.
Rapid double-click each create/save/delete/send/restore/import control and retry after failure; assert no duplicate write, duplicate run, dropped loading state or stale callback.
Direct-link, refresh, in-app links, browser Back/Forward, dirty navigation cancel/confirm, and switch project/interface mid-request; assert target IDs, location and content agree.
Keyboard Tab/Shift-Tab, Enter, Space and Escape; ensure actionable controls are reachable, labels/errors understandable and no trapped focus after close.
At desktop, narrow desktop and mobile widths: inspect clipping, overflow, stacking, AntD dropdown/modal portals, long Unicode titles and tables, loading overlays, tooltip placement and editor height.
After each mutation verify server response, visible state, reload and readback independently; inspect payload for unchanged unrelated fields and expected data types.
Enable/disable each bundled plugin and representative configured external plugins; confirm no duplicate routes/tabs, hook failures or incompatible AntD/router assumptions.

Use real authorized backup-derived fixtures with legacy Markdown/HTML, numeric IDs, empty arrays/nulls, malformed/boolean/multi-type schemas, deep nesting and old collection state; no production mutation.
